overlaps.rationale: Overtime work is the work performed beyond normal hours; overtime pay is the compensation received for that work.
Salary is regular work compensation, whereas overtime pay is compensation specifically for work beyond regular hours.
Employee benefits are non-salary benefits provided by an employer; overtime pay is earnings for extra hours worked.
Pension is a regular payment after retirement, unlike overtime pay earned for work beyond regular hours.
